page.layout: Running head at top: "LIB. III. Scutum Regium." with page number 161 at top right. One text column of running text. One marginal note column at the right, beside the text. Catchword "Imperij" at the lower right. Gathering signature "M" at the lower left. The fragments at the left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: sti[?] Augustini, Sancti Ambrosij vitam scripsit, & quæ diximus, vera esse ingenuus & candidus Lector deprehendet. Neq; interim tamen huic Episcopo defuit illa μεγαλοψυχία[?] & vigor Sacerdotalis, qui tantū Præsulem decebat, quem in Imperatore Theodofio (ob temerariā cædem in{1}Thessalonicenses perpetratam) à communione remouendo, & ad seriam redigendo pœnitentiam insigniter exercuit; Tanta præterea fuit sanctitatis fama, vt ipse Theodofius dicere soleret, solum Ambrofium noui, digne vocari Episcopum. Tanto denique veritatis candore, vt nè inimici quidem eius suffragate Augustino, in eius scriptis quod arguerent invenire poterint. Huic itaq; Capiti quasi columnas figam Herculeas, illam ciusdem diuiniffimi Patris in psalmum 5 o. Enarrationem, qua quid ad propositum præsens rotundius, aut liquidius dici vel fingi posfit, prorsus excogitare non valeo. In illa igitur verba [tibi foli peccaui.] [Rex inquit, vtiq; erat, nullis ipse legibus tenebatur; quia liberi sunt Reges à vinculis delictorum, neque enim vllis ad pœnam vocantur Legibus tuti[?] Theodoretus lib. 5. cap.17. Socrat. lib. 7. cap.24.

page.notes: Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were omitted. Greek word "μεγαλοψυχία" is uncertain and marked. "sti" at the line start is uncertain. The printed "5 o." of the Psalm number is spaced and uncertain. The note "Theodoretus" is hyphenated across lines as "Theodo-/retus" in print; written whole here. The last line ends with "tuti" and the catchword "Imperij" below; "tuti" is marked as uncertain because the scan is faint at the line end.
